question: List the names of all artists whose name starts with 'The'.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Artist WHERE Name LIKE 'The%' ORDER BY Name;

question: What is the email address of the customer named Luís Gonçalves?
gold_sql: SELECT Email FROM Customer WHERE FirstName = 'Luís' AND LastName = 'Gonçalves';

question: List all track names that are longer than 300000 milliseconds.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 300000 ORDER BY Name;

question: Which employees have the job title 'Sales Support Agent'?
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Employee WHERE Title = 'Sales Support Agent' ORDER BY LastName;

question: List all customers who live in Brazil.
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Brazil' ORDER BY LastName;

question: What are the names of all genres?
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Genre ORDER BY Name;

question: List all playlists that have 'Music' in their name.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Playlist WHERE Name LIKE '%Music%';

question: Find the track named 'Balls to the Wall'.
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Composer, Milliseconds FROM Track WHERE Name = 'Balls to the Wall';

question: List customers from the state of California (CA).
gold_sql: SELECT FirstName, LastName, City FROM Customer WHERE State = 'CA' ORDER BY LastName;

question: What is the postal code of the employee named Andrew Adams?
gold_sql: SELECT PostalCode FROM Employee WHERE FirstName = 'Andrew' AND LastName = 'Adams';

question: How many tracks are there in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track;

question: How many customers are there from Germany?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Germany';

question: What is the total number of invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice;

question: What is the average unit price of a track?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track;

question: What is the total sum of all invoice totals?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(Total) FROM Invoice;

question: How many distinct countries do customers come from?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Country) FROM Customer;

question: How many albums does the artist with ArtistId 1 have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Album WHERE ArtistId = 1;

question: What is the longest track duration in milliseconds?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(Milliseconds) FROM Track;

question: What is the shortest track duration in milliseconds, excluding zero?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(Milliseconds) FROM Track WHERE Milliseconds > 0;

question: How many tracks belong to the genre 'Rock'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE g.Name = 'Rock';

question: List the names of all albums by the artist 'AC/DC'.
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title FROM Album al JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE ar.Name = 'AC/DC';

question: List the track names on the album 'Facelift'.
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId WHERE al.Title = 'Facelift';

question: Which genre does the track 'Fast As a Shark' belong to?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name FROM Track t JOIN Genre g ON t.GenreId = g.GenreId WHERE t.Name = 'Fast As a Shark';

question: List the first and last names of customers along with the city of their support representative.
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, e.City AS RepCity FROM Customer c JOIN Employee e ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId;

question: List the first 20 track names along with their media type name.
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name, m.Name AS MediaType FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId ORDER BY t.Name LIMIT 20;

question: List the names of the first 20 tracks in the playlist called 'Music'.
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name FROM Track t JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON t.TrackId = pt.TrackId JOIN Playlist p ON pt.PlaylistId = p.PlaylistId WHERE p.Name = 'Music' ORDER BY pt.TrackId LIMIT 20;

question: What is the total amount billed to each customer named 'Frank Harris'?
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalBilled FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE c.FirstName='Frank' AND c.LastName='Harris' GROUP BY c.CustomerId;

question: List the names of employees and the first names of the employees they report to.
gold_sql: SELECT e1.FirstName AS Employee, e2.FirstName AS Manager FROM Employee e1 JOIN Employee e2 ON e1.ReportsTo = e2.EmployeeId;

question: List all invoice lines for the track named 'Right Next Door to Hell', showing quantity and unit price.
gold_sql: SELECT il.Quantity, il.UnitPrice FROM InvoiceLine il JOIN Track t ON il.TrackId = t.TrackId WHERE t.Name = 'Right Next Door to Hell';

question: List the album title and artist name for the track 'Go Down'.
gold_sql: SELECT al.Title, ar.Name FROM Track t JOIN Album al ON t.AlbumId = al.AlbumId JOIN Artist ar ON al.ArtistId = ar.ArtistId WHERE t.Name = 'Go Down';

question: For each country, how many customers are there? Order by count descending.
gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS NumCustomers FROM Customer GROUP BY Country ORDER BY NumCustomers DESC;

question: For each genre, how many tracks are there? Order by genre name.
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS NumTracks FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY g.Name;

question: Which countries have more than 5 customers?
gold_sql: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) AS NumCustomers FROM Customer GROUP BY Country HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY NumCustomers DESC;

question: For each artist, how many albums do they have? Show only artists with more than 5 albums.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS NumAlbums FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.Name HAVING COUNT(al.AlbumId) > 5 ORDER BY NumAlbums DESC;

question: What is the total sales amount for each employee (by their supported customers' invoices)?
gold_sql: SELECT e.FirstName, e.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSales FROM Employee e JOIN Customer c ON e.EmployeeId = c.SupportRepId JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId ORDER BY TotalSales DESC;

question: For each media type, how many tracks use it?
gold_sql: SELECT m.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS NumTracks FROM MediaType m JOIN Track t ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name ORDER BY NumTracks DESC;

question: Which playlists have more than 500 tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT p.Name, COUNT(pt.TrackId) AS NumTracks FROM Playlist p JOIN PlaylistTrack pt ON p.PlaylistId = pt.PlaylistId GROUP BY p.Name HAVING COUNT(pt.TrackId) > 500 ORDER BY NumTracks DESC;

question: For each billing country, what is the total invoice amount?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) AS TotalAmount FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY TotalAmount DESC;

question: How many albums does each artist have? Show only artists with exactly 1 album.
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS NumAlbums FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.Name HAVING COUNT(al.AlbumId) = 1 ORDER BY ar.Name;

question: What is the average track length in milliseconds for each genre?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, AVG(t.Milliseconds) AS AvgLength FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY AvgLength DESC;

question: What are the 5 most expensive tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT Name, UnitPrice FROM Track ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC, Name ASC LIMIT 5;

question: Who are the top 3 customers by total amount spent?
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(i.Total) AS TotalSpent FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 3;

question: What are the 10 longest tracks by duration?
gold_sql: SELECT Name, Milliseconds FROM Track ORDER BY Milliseconds DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Which 5 genres have the most tracks?
gold_sql: SELECT g.Name, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS NumTracks FROM Genre g JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId GROUP BY g.Name ORDER BY NumTracks DESC LIMIT 5;

question: What are the 3 best-selling tracks by total quantity sold?
gold_sql: SELECT t.Name, SUM(il.Quantity) AS TotalSold FROM Track t JOIN InvoiceLine il ON t.TrackId = il.TrackId GROUP BY t.TrackId ORDER BY TotalSold DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Which artist has the most albums?
gold_sql: SELECT ar.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS NumAlbums FROM Artist ar JOIN Album al ON ar.ArtistId = al.ArtistId GROUP BY ar.Name ORDER BY NumAlbums DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What are the 5 most recent invoices by date?
gold_sql: SELECT InvoiceId, InvoiceDate, Total FROM Invoice ORDER BY InvoiceDate DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Which 5 customers have the most invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT c.FirstName, c.LastName, COUNT(i.InvoiceId) AS NumInvoices FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId ORDER BY NumInvoices DESC LIMIT 5;

question: List the names of the first 20 tracks that have never appeared on any invoice, ordered alphabetically.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Track WHERE TrackId NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT TrackId FROM InvoiceLine) ORDER BY Name LIMIT 20;

question: Which customers have spent more than the average total per invoice?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.FirstName, c.LastName FROM Customer c JOIN Invoice i ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE i.Total > (SELECT AVG(Total) FROM Invoice) ORDER BY c.LastName;

question: List all invoices billed in the year 2021.
gold_sql: SELECT InvoiceId, InvoiceDate, Total FROM Invoice WHERE InvoiceDate LIKE '2021%' ORDER BY InvoiceDate;

question: What distinct billing countries appear in the invoices?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT BillingCountry FROM Invoice ORDER BY BillingCountry;

question: List artists who have no albums in the database.
gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM Artist WHERE ArtistId NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT ArtistId FROM Album);
